title: Delivery guarantees: at-most-once, at-least-once, and the truth about exactly-once
summary: Why exactly-once delivery is unsolvable but exactly-once processing is shippable, and the producer-idempotency + transactional-commit + consumer-dedup pattern that gets you there.
crux: Exactly-once delivery is impossible. Exactly-once processing ships. Idempotent producer + consumer dedup gets you there.
keytakeaway: At-most-once loses, at-least-once duplicates, exactly-once delivery is impossible (Two Generals). The fix: at-least-once + idempotent consumer = effectively exactly-once.
